description: Market data: search coins, prices, movers, supply, and charts.
limitations: Read-only market data. Some endpoints need a paid CoinGecko plan. Not a trading venue.
setup_hint: Connect with a CoinGecko Pro API key.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find CoinGecko coin, NFT, and category ids by name or phrase. Does not return contract addresses; call coin after this.

tools.name: coin
tools.description: Coin id or platform+address → contract addresses and lean market data. Pass id, or platform and address.

tools.name: prices
tools.description: Current USD price, 24h change, and last update for CoinGecko coin ids.

tools.name: new
tools.description: Recently listed coins on CoinGecko. Analyst plan and above.

tools.name: movers
tools.description: Top gainers and losers. Analyst plan and above.

tools.name: supply
tools.description: Circulating, total, and labeled non-circulating wallets. Analyst plan and above.

tools.name: chart
tools.description: Price history or OHLC. Pass id, or platform and address. OHLC requires id. Default 7 days, price series only.

tools.name: trending
tools.description: Trending coins, NFTs, and categories in the last 24 hours.
